title: Look-ahead and survivorship bias
summary: Look-ahead bias uses information that was not available at the time. Survivorship bias studies only what survived, such as methods you heard worked.
unreliableWhen: Both make a test look better than real trading could be, and both are easy to miss on a finished chart.
goodExample: Deciding only on closed bars in Replay, and treating a method you heard about as an idea to test, not as proof.
badExample: Drawing support with a low that formed after your planned entry, then counting the trade as a win.
